title: Непряма мова
rule: У непрямій мові часи зсуваються назад (backshift): am → was, will → would, have done → had done, can → could. Say без обʼєкта (he said that...), tell з обʼєктом (he told me that...). Питання стають розповідним порядком слів без do/does: She asked where I worked. Без питальних слів: if/whether.

items.prompt: 'I'm busy,' she said. She said she ___ busy.
items.explanation: Backshift: am → was.

items.prompt: She ___ that the server was down.
items.explanation: Say вживається без додатка, tell потребує me/him.

items.prompt: 'I'll send the report tomorrow.' He said ___ the report the next day.
items.explanation: Will → would після said.

items.prompt: 'Where do you live?' She asked me where ___.
items.explanation: У непрямому питанні прямий порядок слів і backshift.

items.prompt: 'Did you book the ticket?' He asked if I ___ the ticket.
items.explanation: Past Simple у питанні → Past Perfect, порядок слів прямий.

items.prompt: The manager ___ us to submit the report today.
items.explanation: Tell somebody to do something.

items.prompt: 'Don't touch the config,' he said. He told me ___ the config.
items.explanation: Заборона в непрямій мові — not to + інфінітив.

items.prompt: 'Where is the office?' she asked. She asked where ___.
items.explanation: Прямий порядок слів і was.

items.prompt: 'I'll call you tomorrow,' Tom said. Tom said he ___ me the next day.
items.explanation: Will → would.

items.prompt: 'I bought the car yesterday.' She said that she ___ the car the day before.
items.explanation: Past Simple → Past Perfect, yesterday → the day before.

items.prompt: 'I live in Kyiv,' he said. He said he ___ (live) in Kyiv.
items.explanation: Present Simple → Past Simple.

items.prompt: 'I have finished,' she said. She said she ___ (finish).
items.explanation: Present Perfect → Past Perfect.

items.prompt: 'Can you help me?' he asked. He asked if I ___ (can) help him.
items.explanation: Can → could.

items.prompt: 'Do you like pizza?' she asked. She asked me if I ___ (like) pizza.
items.explanation: Present Simple → Past Simple, без do.

items.prompt: 'Don't be late,' the boss told us. The boss told us ___ (not / be) late.
items.explanation: Наказ у непрямій мові — not to + інфінітив.

items.prompt: 'I'll deploy tomorrow,' he said. He said he ___ (deploy) the next day.
items.explanation: Will → would.

items.prompt: He said me that he would be late.
answers: He told me that he would be late.
He said that he would be late.
items.explanation: Said не вживається з додатком me; потрібен told.

items.prompt: She asked me where do I work.
answers: She asked me where I worked.
items.explanation: У непрямому питанні немає do і порядок слів прямий.

items.prompt: He told that the meeting was cancelled.
answers: He said that the meeting was cancelled.
He told me that the meeting was cancelled.
items.explanation: Tell потребує особи (told me), інакше вживаємо said.

items.prompt: She asked me if I can help her yesterday.
answers: She asked me if I could help her yesterday.
items.explanation: Потрібен backshift: can → could.
